title: Ramen French Dip
description: A fusion twist on the classic French dip, using ramen noodles and bryndza cheese for a unique flavor profile.
instructions: Bring the water to a boil and cook the ramen noodles according to the package instructions.
In a separate pan, heat the sesame oil over medium heat.
Add the miso paste and stir until dissolved.
Add the spicy oozy sauce and stir to combine.
Slice the French bread into thick slices and toast until crispy.
Assemble the sandwiches by placing a portion of the cooked ramen noodles on each slice of bread.
Top with a slice of bryndza cheese and spoon some of the miso-spicy sauce over the top.
